batch.selection: Meta AI 397 份待审母集按冻结顺序排列的第 1 批 60 份资料
batch.admissionRule: 总分至少 6/10，且知识重要性至少 2/3

results.title: Your next build starts with Muse.
results.description: Build with Meta's AI models and tools. Access Muse Spark through Muse Code and Meta Model API with resources to get started.

scores.rationale: 产品门户主要承担入口和营销导航，独立技术知识不足。

results.title: Build with Meta Model API and Muse Code
results.description: Build with Meta Model API and Muse Code: call Muse Spark for agentic and coding work, generate and edit images with Muse Image, transcribe speech with Muse Voice Transcribe, segment images and video with Segment Anything Model, or download Muse Glimmer open weights.

scores.rationale: 文档首页是下级指南的集合导航，核心内容由专题页完整承载。

results.title: API reference
results.description: The Meta Model API HTTP reference — base URL, authentication, and the Responses, Chat Completions, Messages, Files, Models, and Status resources.

scores.rationale: API reference 首页只是端点目录，不能替代具体协议指南或完整 schema。

results.title: Meta Model API cookbook
results.description: Working recipes for building on Meta Model API — API primitives, agent loops, and end-to-end use cases on Muse Spark.

scores.rationale: Cookbook 首页聚合示例，按规则默认属于补充层，且本页本身没有独立机制结论。

results.title: Latest from Meta AI Research
results.description: Research, releases, and ideas from Meta AI.

scores.rationale: 研究门户不属于官方技术文档本批边界，论文应进入学术来源审核。

results.title: AI Developer Help Center
results.description: Find answers to all common topics related to AI Developer products.

scores.rationale: 帮助中心集中处理账号、账单和常见操作，技术学习价值有限。

results.title: Agent frameworks
results.description: Run your own agent loop on Muse Spark with the Claude Agent SDK or the OpenAI Codex app-server.

scores.rationale: 比较 Claude Agent SDK 与 Codex app-server 的代理循环和协议映射，能支持框架接入决策。

results.uniqueDelta: 相较于《Use Model API with coding agents》、《Build a computer-use agent》，本资料的独立增量是：比较 Claude Agent SDK 与 Codex app-server 的代理循环和协议映射，能支持框架接入决策。

results.title: Authentication
results.description: Create and manage API keys for authenticating requests to Meta Model API.

scores.rationale: API 密钥生命周期和请求认证是可靠接入的必要安全边界。

results.uniqueDelta: 相较于《Error handling》、《Pricing and rate limits》，本资料的独立增量是：API 密钥生命周期和请求认证是可靠接入的必要安全边界。

results.title: Use Model API with coding agents
results.description: Connect coding agents like OpenCode, Codex, and Claude Code to Model API and drive Muse Spark for agentic coding workflows.

scores.rationale: 编码代理接入展示兼容配置和工作流，但知识高度依赖具体客户端。

results.uniqueDelta: 相较于《Agent frameworks》、《Build a computer-use agent》，本资料的独立增量是：编码代理接入展示兼容配置和工作流，但知识高度依赖具体客户端。

results.title: Build a computer-use agent
results.description: Drive Muse Spark as a computer-use agent with the native computer tool, turning screenshots into structured mouse and keyboard actions that your own driver executes.

scores.rationale: 原生 computer tool 的截图—动作循环、驱动责任和安全边界构成独特的计算机使用代理机制。

results.uniqueDelta: 相较于《Agent frameworks》、《Use Model API with coding agents》，本资料的独立增量是：原生 computer tool 的截图—动作循环、驱动责任和安全边界构成独特的计算机使用代理机制。

results.title: Error handling
results.description: Handle API errors, troubleshoot common issues, and build resilient Meta Model API integrations with proper retry logic.

scores.rationale: 错误类型、重试、退避和幂等处理直接决定生产集成的可靠性。

results.uniqueDelta: 相较于《Authentication》、《Pricing and rate limits》，本资料的独立增量是：错误类型、重试、退避和幂等处理直接决定生产集成的可靠性。

results.title: File handling
results.description: Send files to the model inline in a Responses or chat completion request, or upload them once with the Files API and reference them by ID.

scores.rationale: 内联文件与 Files API 引用的生命周期差异是多模态请求的重要实现边界。

results.uniqueDelta: 本批同主题没有可直接替代资料；独立增量是：内联文件与 Files API 引用的生命周期差异是多模态请求的重要实现边界。

results.title: Image generation with Muse Image
results.description: Generate and edit images with Muse Image through a conversation: interleave text and reference images and refine across turns on the Responses API, or make one-off calls with the OpenAI-compatible images endpoints.

scores.rationale: 多轮图像生成与编辑的输入、参考图和迭代语义是核心多模态能力。

results.uniqueDelta: 相较于《Image understanding》、《Images schemas》，本资料的独立增量是：多轮图像生成与编辑的输入、参考图和迭代语义是核心多模态能力。

results.title: Image understanding
results.description: Analyze images with text prompts using URLs, base64 encoding, or uploaded files.

scores.rationale: 图像 URL、base64 与已上传文件的输入边界可迁移到多数视觉理解系统。

results.uniqueDelta: 相较于《Image generation with Muse Image》、《Images schemas》，本资料的独立增量是：图像 URL、base64 与已上传文件的输入边界可迁移到多数视觉理解系统。

results.title: Media segmentation
results.description: Detect, segment, and follow objects in images and video from a short text prompt with Segment Anything Model (SAM).

scores.rationale: SAM 的文本提示分割、图像与视频跟踪以及流式掩码输出具有不可替代的模型机制价值。

results.uniqueDelta: 相较于《Build with Meta Model API and Muse Code》、《Segment Anything Model client libraries》，本资料的独立增量是：SAM 的文本提示分割、图像与视频跟踪以及流式掩码输出具有不可替代的模型机制价值。

results.title: Models
results.description: The model families on Meta Model API, spanning Muse Spark, Muse Image, Muse Voice Transcribe, Segment Anything Model segmentation, and the open-weight Muse Glimmer, and how to choose the right model.

scores.rationale: 模型页集中给出各模型家族的能力、输入输出、上下文和托管方式，是选型主依据。

results.uniqueDelta: 本批同主题没有可直接替代资料；独立增量是：模型页集中给出各模型家族的能力、输入输出、上下文和托管方式，是选型主依据。

results.title: Build with Meta Model API and Muse Code
results.description: Build with Meta Model API and Muse Code: call Muse Spark for agentic and coding work, generate and edit images with Muse Image, transcribe speech with Muse Voice Transcribe, segment images and video with Segment Anything Model, or download Muse Glimmer open weights.

results.title: Pricing and rate limits
